# Hansen GFC v1.12 (global_forest_change_2024_v1_12)

Direct forest cover and annual loss baseline; weak supervision only for monthly tasks.

Primary v1 baseline. treecover2000 + lossyear + datamask bands. Annual labels; not suitable as monthly ground truth (see ADR 0004). v3 potential as weak supervision signal.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: Hansen GFC v1.12 (global_forest_change_2024_v1_12)

nodes.context:
# Sentinel-2 MSI L2A

High-resolution optical signal for forest state and disturbance confirmation.

Core v2 input. 10 m optical. Cloud masking required. Monthly compositing with SCL or s2cloudless. v3: usable as input to weakly supervised model.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded. NDVI is derived from reflectance bands, not asserted to be a native dataset band.
nodes.title: Sentinel-2 MSI L2A

nodes.context:
# Sentinel-1 GRD (C-band SAR)

Cloud-robust SAR signal for forest structure and monthly disturbance confirmation.

Cloud-robust v2 complement to Sentinel-2. VV+VH polarizations. Requires speckle filtering and terrain correction. Backscatter sensitive to moisture and structure.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: Sentinel-1 GRD (C-band SAR)

nodes.context:
# JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF)

Independent forest/non-forest and degradation reference for humid tropics.

Annual forest / non-forest classification for the humid tropics. Independent of Hansen GFC - useful for cross-validation. Includes deforestation / degradation classes.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF)

# Monthly non-claims

Hansen annual loss is not monthly ground truth. Annual agreement does not prove monthly correctness. Single-month anomalies do not prove loss or its cause. Monthly products are not legal deforestation ground truth.
nodes.title: Monthly non-claims

nodes.context:
# Annual loss year

Year of first canopy loss, not monthly timing or recurring loss.
nodes.title: Annual loss year

nodes.context:
# Canopy cover

Hansen treecover2000 is percent canopy cover in 2000.
nodes.title: Canopy cover

nodes.context:

Dataset-native annual classes; harmonize forest definitions before comparison.
nodes.title: Forest class transition

nodes.context:
# NDVI

Vegetation index from optical red and near-infrared measurements; not forest class by itself.
nodes.title: NDVI

# Persistence count

Number of consecutive periods satisfying a declared condition; missingness policy required.
nodes.title: Persistence count

nodes.context:
# VV/VH backscatter

Polarized backscatter and declared derived ratio; units and preprocessing must match.
nodes.title: VV/VH backscatter

nodes.context:
# Matched-season interannual comparison

Compare corresponding seasonal windows in reference years and target year using optical and/or SAR. Align season, quality, coverage and sensor processing before calculating current minus reference. Decision rules require explicit configuration and validation. No performance superiority is asserted.

parameters.input_selection: optical | SAR | both, explicitly declared; listed observation edges are alternatives for sensor inputs

nodes.title: Matched-season interannual comparison

nodes.context:
# Monthly compositing

Quality-aware calendar-month composites. Existing v2 reference uses optical median and SAR mean; record coverage and gaps.
nodes.title: Monthly compositing

nodes.context:
# Moving-window comparison

Aggregate declared moving windows and compare with matched reference windows. Mean, median or another declared operator are parameters, not a universal preference. Edge handling, minimum observations and missingness must be explicit.
nodes.title: Moving-window comparison

nodes.context:
# NDVI anomaly

Compare NDVI with a declared reference under quality masks. Reference, anomaly threshold and confounder handling need validation; v2 specifies indicators but not an anomaly classifier.
nodes.title: NDVI anomaly

nodes.context:
# Sentinel-1 backscatter confirmation

Use comparable VV/VH time series as complementary confirmation. v2 requires disagreement flags and preprocessing; backscatter is not uniquely diagnostic of loss.
nodes.title: Sentinel-1 backscatter confirmation

nodes.context:
# Temporal persistence

Require configured consecutive-period conditions (v2 default N=2); declare treatment of missingness and focal-month attribution.
nodes.title: Temporal persistence

nodes.context:
# Disturbance confirmation

Combine temporal and optical/SAR evidence; flag disagreement. Confirmation is conditional on validation, not cause attribution.
nodes.title: Disturbance confirmation

nodes.context:
# Forest baseline

Declared baseline forest extent, definition, MMU, exclusions and nodata; baseline is not a current forest census.
nodes.title: Forest baseline

nodes.context:
# Forest-cover change

Change relative to a declared forest definition and reference period; temporal meaning follows the input labels.
nodes.title: Forest-cover change

nodes.context:
# Optical vegetation state

Quality-masked optical evidence; clouds, shadows and phenology limit interpretation.
nodes.title: Optical vegetation state

nodes.context:
# SAR structural/backscatter state

Comparable SAR backscatter with declared polarization, orbit and preprocessing; moisture and terrain confound structure.
nodes.title: SAR structural/backscatter state

nodes.context:
# Temporal persistence

Repeated conditions over explicitly configured periods; missing observations are not negative evidence.
nodes.title: Temporal persistence

Select methods according to required observations and validated context, then resolve datasets and executable implementations.
nodes.title: How do corresponding seasonal observation windows differ between reference and target years?

# sentinel-monthly-forest-cover

Executable downstream workflow (an implementation, not a scientific method). It may implement
several methods partially; IMPLEMENTS edges are candidate registrations, not audited scientific
equivalence. Each edge scope distinguishes relationships declared by the pinned implementation
descriptor from proposed target-contract relationships it does not yet implement. Downstream
descriptors and run manifests are validated against these registered relationships, so a new
implementation relationship must be proposed here first. The implementation pins its own
version, declares divergences and must demonstrate validation.
